description: blend/cylinder-rim-spindle-fillet with a cylinder of radius 0.3 fused across its spindle blend: the cylinder's axis is the line x = 1.5, z = 2.6 along y, off the blend's axis, and crosses the band face, the top plane and the wall. The result is an operand of a boolean, as the ring torus's faces are (ADR-0080)

analytic.step_differs: Open CASCADE's own STEP of its result reads back with the right counts, volume, area and centroid, but its inertia moves by more than the shape's own tolerance allows: Ixx 57.9124 where it built 57.9086, Iyy 56.1730 where it built 56.1768 and Ixy -1.3e-4 where it built -2.8e-12, a relative 6.5e-5 against the 1.5e-6 the shape's 1e-7 vertex tolerance admits; Arris's STEP of the same result is still read back by Open CASCADE and held to the fixture's tolerances (the corpus's compare stage)
